title: Insects and their bodies
examples: What are the main parts of an insect's body?
Do all insects have the same number of legs?
Can you name the three sections of an insect?

explain.say: Look closely at this picture of an insect.

items: Head: Where the eyes and mouth are
Thorax: Where the legs and wings attach
Abdomen: The rear section of the body

draw.text: Insect Body Parts: Head, Thorax, Abdomen

explain.say: The first main part is the head. This is where the insect sees and eats.
Next is the thorax. This middle part is strong and holds the legs and wings.

draw.text: Thorax: Legs and wings attach here

explain.say: The last part is the abdomen. This rear section helps the insect move and store food.
All insects have six legs. You can count them on the thorax section.
Think about a ladybug crawling on a leaf outside.

faq.q: Do all bugs have three body parts?
faq.a: Yes, most insects have three main body parts. These are the head, the thorax, and the abdomen.
asks: What are the insect body sections?
How many parts does an insect have?

faq.q: Why do insects have six legs?
faq.a: Insects are built to have six legs for walking and jumping. This is a key feature of the insect group.
asks: How many legs should an insect have?
Is six legs normal for bugs?

faq.q: What is the difference between the thorax and the abdomen?
faq.a: The thorax is the middle section where the legs and wings attach. The abdomen is the rear section of the body.
asks: Where do the legs come from?
What is the job of the rear body part?

faq.a: No, spiders are not insects. They have eight legs, which is different from the six legs insects have.
asks: How many legs does a spider have?

faq.a: No, not all insects have wings. Some types, like ants, walk without any wings at all.
asks: Can an insect live without wings?

facts: Insects have three main body parts: head, thorax, and abdomen.
The thorax is the section that holds the insect's legs and wings.
All insects have six legs, arranged in three pairs.
The head holds the insect's eyes and mouthparts for eating.

quiz.say: Which part connects the legs and wings?
quiz.why: The thorax is the middle section where the legs and wings are attached.

wrong.0: Six legs is a number, not the body part name.
wrong.2: The head is where the insect sees and eats, not where the legs attach.
wrong.3: The abdomen is the rear part of the body, not the leg attachment point.

quiz.say: How many legs should a true insect have?
quiz.why: Insects are scientifically known to always have exactly six legs.

wrong.0: Eight legs belong to spiders, which are not insects.
wrong.1: Four legs are too few for a typical insect.
wrong.2: Insects do not have that many legs; they have a small number.

quiz.say: If you look at a beetle, which part is the rear section?
quiz.why: The abdomen is the final, rear part of the insect's body.

wrong.0: The head is always the front part where the mouth is.
wrong.1: The thorax is the middle part that holds the walking parts.
wrong.2: Legs are attached to the thorax, not the name for the rear section.
